request-prompt: Change the default page theme to a full dark mode wrapper and automatically set the default map style to 'Satellite' instead of 'Light' so the colors are instantly dark and rich upon loading.
goal: I prefer dark-themed interfaces and high-detail satellite imagery across all apps and sites to minimize eye strain and view realistic textures.
jobs: I want to track current and upcoming precipitation in my area by viewing the interactive radar map
I want to see how a storm is moving over time by playing the radar timeline animation
I want to check the weather radar for a different city or zip code using the search bar
I want to customize the weather map layers to view specific conditions like wind speed, temperature, or UV index
I want to monitor active severe weather threats such as hurricanes, lightning, or storm warnings on the map
I want to quickly find out when rain or snow is expected to start in my current location
I want to switch the map's visual style, such as to satellite or dark mode, to better visualize the weather patterns

preference-pairs.a: I am a data-driven user who likes to dive deep into complex, customizable data visualizations and maps to analyze details and draw my own conclusions.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer simple, straightforward text-based summaries and pre-made reports over interactive maps that require manual configuration.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer dark-themed interfaces and high-detail satellite imagery across all apps and sites to minimize eye strain and view realistic textures.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer light-themed interfaces and clean, high-contrast, simplified maps because they are easier for me to read quickly.

preference-pairs.a: I am highly protective of my digital privacy, so I strictly reject tracking, cookies, and geolocation prompts, and avoid signing in to websites.
preference-pairs.b: I prioritize seamless convenience, so I readily enable location tracking, accept cookies, and sign in to get highly personalized local content automatically.
